rationale: The contractor fixed the loose heater connection during the inspection the landlord approved, and now quotes £95 including VAT for a missing dial, asking whether to proceed (019). That is new spend beyond the approved inspection. The agency forwarded the quote to the landlord and held for authorisation (020, 021); the landlord approved (022) before the contractor was instructed (023). Nothing shows how the dial went missing, so charging the tenant has no basis.
